scope: rejected programmatic-rendered curve and tie visual experiments; not end-to-end OMR accuracy

experiments.name: generic_tie_and_slur_arc_presence_model
experiments.reason: short same-endpoint slurs and ties were not separable at the zero-false-accept boundary; a generic curve model would exceed its semantic authority

experiments.name: early_64x32_tie_descriptor_lower_threshold
experiments.reason: the compact descriptor produced tail false accepts at the selected lower threshold and was replaced by a larger deterministic matched-curve descriptor

experiments.name: enhanced_descriptor_first_untouched_tail_at_0_889570
experiments.reason: the first untouched rendered tail exposed one false accept; the dataset was reclassified as safety calibration and the deployment floor was raised before a new independent set was generated

experiments.name: enhanced_descriptor_second_untouched_tail_at_0_914230
experiments.reason: a second independently seeded tail exposed one false accept below the fixed 0.92 floor; it was incorporated only as safety evidence, never as final test evidence

experiments.name: source_backed_tie_removal
experiments.reason: absence of a visible curve cannot be established reliably from a bounded noisy crop; removals remain review-only

accepted_replacement.included: source-backed complete addition of an adjacent same-pitch same-voice within-measure tie
accepted_replacement.excluded: tie removal, cross-measure tie change, non-adjacent tie change, and same-endpoint or other slur classification
